note: Manual tags per model; the semantic group is assigned separately and a model belongs to one group but can carry several tags. type is 'material' (what the thing is made of, closed set the lint checks) or 'tag' (anything else worth finding). A material may name a parent: the filter shows the parent and expands to its subtypes, and a model carries the subtype it actually is — the parent is never added on top. Counting rules N1-N3 count every material tag a model carries, subtypes included. Descriptions state the membership rule, not the members: the models list is the membership. Set with catalog/swipe.html; build-catalog.mjs attaches them to catalog.json. po: true marks a tag only the PO assigns.

tags.name: Metal
tags.description: Metal with no subtype named: use it only where the reading is metal but neither iron, gold, silver nor copper fits.

tags.name: Iron
tags.description: Iron, steel and cast iron where it dominates or is the working part: tools, weapons, fittings, bars, grates, lanterns. Steel and cast iron may take blue-grey 6,1 (M12). A model may carry a second metal subtype for its trim.

tags.name: Gold
tags.description: Gold: bars, nuggets, coins, rings, gold keys and trim. Takes gold 6,0 (M13).

tags.name: Silver
tags.description: Silver: bars, nuggets and their stacks, and blades that read as silver. Takes light blue-grey 3,2 (M13, C3).

tags.name: Copper
tags.description: Copper: bars, nuggets and their stacks. Takes terracotta 5,0 (M14) and never shares a model with another metal subtype.

tags.name: Wood
tags.description: Worked wood with no band named: use it only where none of planks, worked, beam, log or bark fits.

tags.name: Planks
tags.description: The surface reads as planks, cut square: signs, staves, boards, plank floors, plank furniture, scaffolding. Takes wood light 0,0 (M42).

tags.name: Worked
tags.description: Planks shaped into a thing rather than lying as stock: barrels, kegs, buckets, crates, chests, trunks, plank furniture. Takes wood middle 1,0 (M42).

tags.name: Beam
tags.description: Wood doing structural work: posts, beams, pillars, frames, braces, masts, spars, shafts and hafts. Takes wood dark 2,0 (M42).

tags.name: Log
tags.description: Round uncut trunk sections and things built from them: logs, firewood, campfires, log pilings, round-post fences.

tags.name: Bark
tags.description: The outside of a trunk, branch or root: trees, stumps, roots, rough trunks. A cut trunk carries wood-log too (M7).

tags.name: Stone
tags.description: Stone with no subtype named: use it only where neither masonry, rock nor soil fits.

tags.name: Masonry
tags.description: Stone someone has laid or hewn: walls, bricks, floors, columns, stairs, paving. Raw stone is stone-rock.

tags.name: Rock
tags.description: Raw stone as it lies: boulders, pebbles, gravel, rubble, formations, mountains. Hewn stone is stone-masonry.

tags.name: Soil
tags.description: Loose ground: sand and dirt patches, dirt floors and tiles. Laid paving is stone-masonry.

tags.name: Paper
tags.description: Paper and parchment: books, scrolls, maps, open or closed.

tags.name: Textile
tags.description: Woven cloth: canvas, sails, banners, bedding, sacks, clothing. Cordage is rope; hide is leather.

tags.name: Leather
tags.description: Tanned hide: belts, straps, boots, bracers, quivers, bags, book covers, strapping on bundles.

tags.name: Flora
tags.description: Anything that grows or has grown, living or dead: trees, stumps, branches, flowers, grass, mushrooms, cacti, grain, weeds. Pairs with foliage, bark or vegetation for the material.

tags.name: Foliage
tags.description: The light-green part of a plant: leaves, needles, fronds, grass blades, stems, cactus bodies, lily pads. M2-M4 and C8 give it its band.

tags.name: Ceramic
tags.description: Fired clay: jugs, vases, plates, bowls, pots, ceramic bottles, roof tiles.

tags.name: Bone
tags.description: Bone as bone: loose bones, ribcages, skulls, and the bone in a joint of meat.

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Edible matter: bread, cheese, fish, meat, dishes and set plates. Meat additionally carries meat.

tags.name: Wax
tags.description: Candle wax, lit or unlit, loose or on a holder.

tags.name: Glass
tags.description: Glass: bottles, potions, windows, lantern and lamp panes, lenses.

tags.name: Liquid
tags.description: What a vessel visibly holds: the potion in a flask. Not the vessel itself.

tags.name: Emissive
tags.description: Lit and giving light: a burning flame, glowing lantern, lamp or beacon. Unlit holders carry fire or lamp only.

tags.name: Rope
tags.description: Rope and cord: bundles, rigging, rope fences and railings, bell pulls, well ropes.

tags.name: Cork
tags.description: A cork stopper in a bottle or flask, or anything cut from cork.

tags.name: Fauna
tags.description: Animal, apart from bone: fish, sea life, shells, starfish. Any colour goes.

tags.name: Gemstone
tags.description: A cut stone set in jewellery or a hilt.

tags.name: Special
tags.description: A PO-approved joker: exempts one band on the model from one appendix A rule. The band and reason are recorded per model under reasons; a special without one is a finding.

reasons.fantasy-town-kit/fountain-round-detail: blue 4,2 — C4: the water in its basin, blue per M28; C4’s minor-accent cap does not fit a body of water.

reasons.restaurant/food-ingredient-cheese: yellow 6,0 — C5: cheese is yellow because cheese is yellow; food is none of precious metal, emissive or fire.

reasons.rpgtools/pencil-b-long: yellow 6,0 — C5: a pencil is yellow by the convention of the thing itself.

reasons.village-kit/stucco-block: render — appendix A gives stucco no material and no band.

tags.name: Plastic
tags.description: Moulded plastic, dark red or yellow: the platformer kit's game pieces.

tags.name: Vegetation
tags.description: A plant's matter that is neither light-green nor wood: blooms, mushroom caps and stems, dried stalks, husks, grain. M44 gives it its bands.

tags.name: Skin
tags.description: Bare skin of a human figure: face, hands, arms. Skeletons are bone; sea creatures are fauna.

tags.name: Container
tags.description: Anything you put something in: bags, barrels, kegs, crates, boxes, buckets, chests, cages, bottles, jugs.

tags.name: Meat
tags.description: Meat and dishes made of it: chicken leg, steak, ham, roast, stew. Also carries food.

tags.name: Grain
tags.description: Food made of grain: bread, rolls, baguettes, croissants, waffles, buns. Also carries food. M51 gives it taupe 14,3.

tags.name: Decorated food
tags.description: Food finished on top rather than left plain: icing, sprinkles, cream, fruit or candles. N3 and N4 allow it more bands.

tags.name: Key
tags.description: A key, keyring or hanging keyring.

tags.name: Tableware
tags.description: What you eat and drink from at table: plates, bowls, cups, mugs, cutlery.

tags.name: Palms
tags.description: Palm trees.

tags.name: Conifers
tags.description: Needle trees: pines, firs, spruces.

tags.name: Fungi
tags.description: Mushrooms, and a log they grow on.

tags.name: Cacti
tags.description: Cacti, flowering or not.

tags.name: Branch
tags.description: Bare wood without leaves: loose branches, roots, leafless and dead trees.

tags.name: Ladder
tags.description: What you climb straight up: ladders and step ladders, whole or broken.

tags.name: Stairs
tags.description: Steps you walk up: stairs of stone or wood, with or without handrail.

tags.name: Fences
tags.description: What marks off a path or area: fences, gates, posts, rope fences, board fences, their corners and curves.

tags.name: Doors
tags.description: Doorways and what closes them: doors, arches, gates in a wall, doorframes.

tags.name: Floor
tags.description: What you stand on once laid: floor tiles, wooden floors, platforms, dock decks, their broken and grated variants.

tags.name: Scroll
tags.description: Rolled or loose sheets: scrolls, maps, parchment. Bound books are not scrolls.

tags.name: Coins
tags.description: Money: loose coins, coin stacks and heaps.

tags.name: Furniture
tags.description: What furnishes a room: beds, chairs, stools, benches, tables, shelves, whole or broken.

tags.name: Roofs
tags.description: What goes on top of a building: roof pieces, ridges, eaves, edges, corners.

tags.name: Barrel
tags.description: A staved and hooped barrel or keg, open or closed, single or stacked.

tags.name: Bag
tags.description: What you carry over a shoulder: bags, sacks, backpacks, satchels.

tags.name: Chest
tags.description: A lidded chest, open or closed.

tags.name: Seating
tags.description: What you sit on: chairs, stools, benches.

tags.name: Tables
tags.description: A table, whole or broken. What stands on it is tagged separately.

tags.name: Lamp
tags.description: Light in a housing made to stay where it is put: lanterns, street lamps, wall lamps, post lamps, the lighthouse.

tags.name: Fire
tags.description: An open flame or what carries one, lit or not: candles, torches, campfires, braziers. Lit ones also carry emissive.

tags.name: Pans
tags.description: What you cook in: pots, pans, kettles, cauldrons.

tags.name: Boats
tags.description: Small craft, rowed or single-sailed, with or without oars.

tags.name: Ships
tags.description: Big hulls: ships in every size, wrecks, ghost ships.

tags.name: Window
tags.description: An opening in a wall you look through: windows and window frames, open or shuttered.

tags.name: Skull
tags.description: A skull, loose, piled or worn. Also carries bone.

tags.name: Pirate
tags.description: Pirate-themed props and scenery from any kit: ships, boats, cannons, flags, treasure, palms, the pirate crew.

tags.name: Halloween
tags.description: Everything for a Halloween or graveyard build: the halloween and graveyard kits, bones, candles, lanterns, cobwebs, dead trees, dark stone.

tags.name: Robin Hood
tags.description: A Sherwood archer's camp: rangers and rogues, bows and arrows, campfires, logs, tents, forest props.

tags.name: Flags
tags.description: Cloth on a pole or hung from a wall: flags, banners, pennants.

tags.name: Signs
tags.description: Signs and signposts, with or without a post.

tags.name: Ngons
tags.description: Built around a round cross-section: bowls, plates, pots, mugs, coins, rings, candles, barrels, buckets, logs, wheels, masts. Rule §2 counts their facets.

tags.name: Character
tags.description: A figure: adventurers, pirates, skeletons and the like. Not the chests or props they come with.

tags.name: Hero
tags.description: A larger set piece built to stand out: houses, ships, the balloon, the lighthouse, the well, the waterwheel, the compass.

tags.name: Coconut
tags.description: A coconut, whole or halved.

tags.name: Resources
tags.description: Raw and refined stock: ore, nuggets, bars, bricks, textiles, logs, planks, parts, and their stacks.

tags.name: Bottles
tags.description: Bottles and potion flasks, glass or ceramic, empty or filled, single or crated.

tags.name: Jugs
tags.description: Jugs, pitchers and vases.

tags.name: Weapons
tags.description: Arms: arrows, bows, crossbows, blades, axes, staves, wands, shields.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Hand tools and tool-shaped props: hammers, saws, pickaxes, knives, cutlery, buckets, cogs, parts.

tags.name: Flowers
tags.description: An individual flower or flower cluster.

tags.name: Grass
tags.description: Grass tufts, clumps and patches, and standing grain.

tags.name: Stacks
tags.description: A grouped or piled quantity of one item: bar stacks, brick stacks, coin stacks, plank stacks, book stacks.
